actual_contract: Private non-Clone close-only registration is obtained from the actual Required channel; it allocates no new FD or Gate stream and shares a single AtomicBool with the original channel.
Only the actual four-cap acknowledged Root Intent may authorize the same-Gate close. It is not business admission or a completion proof.
Retirement is consumed before socket shutdown. Every original Required require_open checks retirement before and after the unchanged Gate check; unexpected later admission closes the phase.

Under the same Gate mutex, actual original deadline is checked and only the exact registered UnixStream alias is shutdown(Both); the same socket and all clones become EOF, while registration and armed failure guards remain held.
After shutdown, original Gate and actual Root peer/end are checked again; any error closes the common Gate. Poison, repeated retirement, absent registration and wrong Gate are terminal.
No common Gate close occurs on successful purpose retirement; no guard is disarmed, no alias is removed, no future owner is assumed joined.
limits: The actual Runtime and Learning/Model/Publication owner hooks must call this only after their genuine quiescence/join proofs; this generic close-only object does not prove those facts.
No normal Startup success or Root ACK2/OS-exit claim is introduced.
Existing absent-phase paths, the original Gate deadline fields and old fault shutdown mechanism are preserved.
